cbor.name: map-key-order-length-first
cbor.note: keys sort by ENCODED bytes: v < id < cls < conf (length first)

cbor.name: map-key-order-reversed-input
cbor.note: same bytes as map-key-order-length-first despite reversed input

cbor_reject.name: tag-datetime
cbor_reject.reason: CBOR tags are outside the subset

dac.name: dac-genesis-no-parents
dac.note: empty parent set; REGULATED so hitl is forced true

dac.name: dac-with-interval
dac.note: decimal-pair interval; validity spans the full representable range

dac.name: dac-non-ascii-fields
dac.note: non-ASCII in kind, method and monitor id; raw UTF-8 throughout

dac.name: dac-max-length-fields
dac.note: 2-byte length arguments throughout; 64 parents; zero-width validity

dac.name: dac-with-ext
dac.note: ext carries EPHEMERIS domain fields; the envelope timestamp stays UTC

entry.name: entry-genesis
entry.note: genesis prev is 32 zero bytes, which is '0'*64 in hex

entry.name: entry-with-ext-ns
entry.note: nanosecond precision preserved in the signed ext map

entry.name: entry-empty-payload
entry.note: empty event type, empty payload, zero timestamp

entry.name: entry-non-ascii
entry.note: non-ASCII event type; payload bytes are attested, not interpreted

entry.name: entry-float-payload
entry.note: application floats are fine INSIDE an opaque payload; the no-float rule binds the envelope and the ext map, not attested blobs

near_miss.name: near-miss-first-byte-flipped
near_miss.reason: one bit flipped in the first signature byte

near_miss.name: near-miss-last-byte-flipped
near_miss.reason: one bit flipped in the last signature byte

near_miss.name: near-miss-wrong-domain
near_miss.reason: valid signature over the same map under DOMAIN_CHAIN; domain separation must reject it

near_miss.name: near-miss-different-prev
near_miss.reason: valid signature over the same claim with a different prev; rejected only because prev is inside the v1 signature

near_miss.name: target-signing-bytes-hex
near_miss.reason: the one signature that must verify

quantize.name: value-floor-double-below-literal
quantize.note: the double nearest 0.99 is strictly below it; floor is 989999. floor(0.99 * 1e6) returns 990000 and inflates the claim.

quantize.name: value-floor-double-exact
quantize.note: this double quantizes exactly; no divergence

quantize.name: alpha-ceil-double-above
quantize.note: the double nearest 0.05 is above it; ceil is 50001, which never understates the miscoverage rate

quantize.name: issued-at-ceil
quantize.note: window start never earlier than truth

quantize.name: expires-at-floor
quantize.note: window end never later than truth

schema_reject.name: expiry-before-issue
schema_reject.reason: validity window ends before it starts

schema_reject.name: parents-unsorted
schema_reject.reason: parent ids must be sorted bytewise
